meta.title: OpenCode Go Quota
meta.description: OpenCode Go quota: a persistent ring gauge in the left sidebar footer (the arc is the tightest window's remaining share; hover for all three windows, click to open the panel) plus the quota tab in the right sidebar — the rolling 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows with used and remaining share, reset countdowns, and the fixed $12 / $30 / $60 caps. The Host polls the OpenCode Go usage API, reusing DSH's own credential first; the key never reaches the browser.
